content: Three.js current stable is r184 (0.184.0, March 2026). r171 (Sept 2025) made WebGPU production-ready with zero-config imports and automatic WebGL2 fallback. WebGPU now on all major browsers (Safari 26 shipped Sept 2025). Three.js has 270x more npm downloads than Babylon.js (~2.7M/week). For fullscreen fragment shader backgrounds, use ShaderMaterial or RawShaderMaterial with a fullscreen triangle/plane geometry. Post-processing rewritten as RenderPipeline node graph in r183. Color management enabled by default since r151.
